title: A filtered service and a down host

context.question: Which saved observations agree with the approved inventory, and which need an owner check?

data.nmap_xml:
<nmaprun scanner="nmap">
  <host>
    <status state="up"/>
    <address addr="192.0.2.10" addrtype="ipv4"/>
    <ports>
      <port protocol="tcp" portid="443"><state state="filtered"/></port>
    </ports>
  </host>
  <host>
    <status state="down"/>
    <address addr="192.0.2.20" addrtype="ipv4"/>
  </host>
</nmaprun>
